sources.title: Monitoring
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's monitoring page publishes Housing Delivery Action Plans and Authority Monitoring Reports, including the 2023-24 report with five-year housing land supply; these are borough monitoring controls rather than parcel determinations.

sources.title: Registers
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's Brownfield Land Register is reviewed at least annually; Part 1 records previously developed sites meeting suitability, availability and achievability criteria, while the page states register presence does not itself establish planning permission.

sources.title: Emerging plans
sources.verified_claim: Enfield states its five-year land-supply assessment is updated annually and applies high-level constraints including Flood Zone 3, ancient woodland, SSSI and protected land; land-supply assessment remains changeable over the year.

sources.title: Authority Monitoring Reports
sources.verified_claim: Havering publishes its 2024-25 Authority Monitoring Report with housing trajectory, five-year land supply and employment-land monitoring appendices.

sources.title: Housing Delivery Test and Action Plan
sources.verified_claim: Havering explains the Housing Delivery Test as an annual measurement against local housing requirements and uses action plans to assess under-delivery causes and corrective actions when required.

sources.title: Brownfield Land Register
sources.verified_claim: Havering's Brownfield Land Register identifies previously developed sites assessed as suitable for housing-led development but warns mapped boundaries are not definitive and should be checked against original planning sources.

sources.title: Havering Character Study
sources.verified_claim: Havering's Character Study informs the new Local Plan and planning applications, identifies growth opportunities and challenges, and explores medium-high density intensification and tall-building scope while requiring response to local context.

sources.title: Housing evidence base
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's housing evidence catalogue includes housing strategy, SHMA and SHLAA material largely from 2017-2020; the evidence is retained with age limitations and is not treated as current parcel-specific proof.
